source_locator.description: Driven by troubles, cruel hunger, and villains who plunder maidens' chastity, Kalyani has reached the very edge of her life.

translation.english_text: (Driven by troubles, the cruelty of hunger, and villains who plunder maidens' chastity, Kalyani has reached the very edge of her life.)

notes: The source's `உலகத்தின் பெயரைச் சொல்லி ... அம்மா என்று கொஞ்சுகிறாயா?` is syntactically and rhetorically pressure-sensitive; the first pass keeps the world/`Amma` sequence without supplying a psychological explanation.
`திசைகாட்டி? அதுவே என் சகம் காட்டி!` contains the verified pressure-sensitive form `சகம்`; `sagam kaatti` is left transliterated rather than silently repaired.
`சொரணையற்றவர்கள்` is rendered broadly as lacking the sense to give food; its exact colloquial force should be revisited in second pass.
`கன்னித்தமிழே` is retained as `Kannithamizh` as a source endearment rather than expanded into an external cultural gloss.
translation.english_text: Dear child! There is the path to our world. If we go to that world, there will be no hunger! Are you trying to take my life by uttering the name of this world—cooing 'Amma'? No. I am going to kill the very life for whose sake I carried this ruined life. I cannot leave you to live alone in this deceitful world. Jewel crawling in my lap, I am going to leave you to crawl in this river. A guide to the way? That itself is my `sagam kaatti`! I am going to send you along the path this river shows. Those without even the sense to give food have at least cut this river for people to fall into and die! Come, let us go to a place without poverty. Give me your last kiss! Won't you? Kannithamizh, give me one tight kiss. Give your last kiss on these dried lips! Give it. Give it.

source_locator.description: Kalyani throws the child into the river; police arrive, pursue her as she jumps into the river, and capture her.

notes: The source action order is preserved without adding outcome details not printed in this scene.
translation.english_text: (Kalyani lifts the child and throws it into the river. At that moment the police arrive and pursue Kalyani; she too jumps into the river, and the police take her into custody.)

notes: The source's diamond-and-sledgehammer image is retained even though the physical metaphor is unusual.
translation.english_text: Death would be far better than suffering like this. Like a sledgehammer blow falling on a diamond, our family has crumpled and shattered. Where has Kalyani gone? What became of my brothers? Gnana Sekaran! Chandrasekaran!
